_comment: PUBLIC Supabase config the desktop app uses to log an operator in and fetch the engine secrets (migration 028). These two values are NOT secret: they are the exact same project URL and anon/publishable key the Vercel website already ships to every browser, so committing them here is safe. Fill them once. Leave them empty and the app falls back to reading server/.env from beside the app, exactly as before. CI can override at build time with CANON_SUPABASE_URL / CANON_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
